mentions.name: wafertown
mentions.description: An LLM-powered online role-playing game (LLMORPG) where players craft a prompt that goes to live in Wafer Town and interacts with other players' prompts. Prompts can be changed once per day, and the next day players receive news about what their prompt did there. The project is a few days old and very early, with manual operations while sign-ups and other processes are being automated.
mentions.source_excerpt:
wafertown (few days old!)

World's first LLMORPG. You craft a prompt and it goes to live in wafertown and interact with other players (I mean prompts), you can change your prompt once per day, then next day you get news about what you did there!
